fix(dart): normalize non-8bit image inputs

Summary:
- normalize non-uint8 inputs before running Atkinson dithering
- normalize non-uint8 inputs before Pbita top-bit packing
- add uint16 regression tests for both image-processing paths

Rationale:
- main still assumes decoded pixels already use 8-bit channel semantics
- iOS non-8bit images can therefore be treated as white or blank output
- DAM-66 only needs the normalization fix, not the later tuning changes

Tests:
- cd dart/algorithms/dithering && dart test test/non_8bit_regression_test.dart
- cd dart/algorithms/imageb && dart test test/non_8bit_regression_test.dart
- cd dart/algorithms/dithering && dart analyze . && dart test
- cd dart/algorithms/imageb && dart analyze . && dart test
